name: Slawi

queries.query: Slawi peta bidang tanah GIS kadaster BPN Kabupaten Tegal kantor pertanahan resmi
queries.scope: Find a Slawi/Tegal-specific land registry and any anonymous parcel geometry endpoint.
queries.result: Official Kabupaten Tegal sources document the Kantor Pertanahan in Slawi and local cadastral map registration/integration with PBB-P2. The BHUMI public app advertises map searching, but its inspected client routes parcel data through login/token bootstrap; no anonymous full-vector request was made or verified.

queries.query: site:tegalkab.go.id Slawi peta bidang tanah GIS kadaster peta persil BPN Kabupaten Tegal
queries.scope: Search the regency government for local parcel map and cadastral evidence.
queries.result: Found a local-government report describing synchronization of Kantor Pertanahan parcel maps with tax objects; 745,771 of 775,224 regency plots were mapped at the time of the 2024 report. This is regency-level coverage, not an anonymous vector export or a Slawi-only geometry sample.

queries.query: Slawi Indonesia official land registry cadastral parcel map Tegal Regency GIS BPN
queries.scope: Cross-check English-language local office and public map references.
queries.result: Official local sources confirm the land office location in Slawi; no anonymous public parcel polygon service was found.

portals.name: Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Tegal
portals.observation: Official office page locates the land office at Jl. A. Yani No. 7, Slawi. This supports local registry presence, not public feature geometry.

portals.name: BHUMI ATR/BPN
portals.operator: Ministry of Agrarian Affairs and Spatial Planning / National Land Agency
portals.observation: Public map UI discovered, but inspected parcel APIs use authentication/bootstrap tokens. No login, token flow, or protected data request was attempted.

requests.observation: Official Kantor Pertanahan Kab. Tegal page confirms location and local office.
Local-government report says BPN parcel maps are used for synchronization with tax records and states 745,771/775,224 mapped plots at report date.

freshResearch.observedCandidate: The national BHUMI client exposes a map UI but the inspected routes require auth/bootstrap; no public anonymous polygon endpoint verified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Tegal serves the regency and is physically located in Slawi; official local reporting describes parcel-map coverage/integration at regency level.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Registry existence and historical parcel-map program are verified. No anonymous full-polygon feature response or Slawi-specific coverage was verified.

technicalBlocker: No anonymous city-scoped full-polygon service verified. The BHUMI map client’s inspected data routes depend on login/token bootstrap; credentialed calls were outside this public-read check.
remainingUncertainty: Whether an unauthenticated Slawi-specific feature API or export exists outside the inspected BHUMI client; regency mapping totals do not establish coverage at the WUP centroid.
nextStep: Ask the local land office whether a public anonymous vector endpoint exists; if a true public route is identified, run bounded polygon and completeness checks before use.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Official ATR/BPN local office page plus Kabupaten Tegal government report documenting parcel-map registry activity and tax-data integration.
